verdict.rationale: GitCafe's own stack tooling acts on many items at once. `cafe stack submit` opens or reuses one pull request per commit in a single command, Land merges a whole stack bottom-up, and the UI offers Restack, Unstack and Close stack. GitHub sync also imports issues, PRs, reviews and comments wholesale. Beyond stacks and import, there is no documented general-purpose bulk action such as mass-labeling, closing or editing many issues or PRs. Scriptable CLI flags and the REST API are only building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: general bulk edit/close/label across issues and PRs, bulk operations across repositories, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the stack batch operations.
